question: Birkenstock Arizona Essentials EVA: verify its footbed material, upper/sole construction, and waterproof claim.

criteria.fact: The Essentials EVA footbed is EVA, not the classic cork-latex footbed.
Upper, lining and sole are one-piece molded EVA.
Birkenstock describes the EVA variant as waterproof.

question: US Salomon Speedcross 6 GTX: check waterproofness, cleaning/drying, and whether wet-feet reviews prove a model-wide defect.

criteria.fact: The GTX/GORE-TEX variant has a waterproof, breathable membrane; do not transfer that claim to the ordinary Speedcross 6.
Clean dirt and mud with water and a soft wet brush.
Salomon says not to machine-wash the shoes.
Dry at room temperature without direct sun or an external heat source.
Individual reviews cannot establish a model-wide defect or a numerical failure rate without representative evidence.
Wet-feet reports alone do not identify the entry route or prove that this individual pair has a defective membrane.

question: Listing says only Birkenstock Arizona, no material or photos. Can I soak them? Ask for what you need before a definite answer.

criteria.fact: Ask for the material/variant or identifying photos/model details before deciding whether soaking is appropriate.
Do not assume every Arizona is EVA or transfer the EVA waterproof specification to a cork-latex model.
Give no unconditional instruction to soak an unidentified pair. Conditional explanations are acceptable.

question: Apple MacBook Air M2 2022: verify native external-display count/resolution and Thunderbolt/USB4 port count.

criteria.fact: Native support is one external display, not the M3/M4 display configuration.
The supported external display is up to 6K at 60 Hz.
There are two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports.

question: Dell XPS 13 9310 clamshell 16GB: assess RAM/SSD upgrades and safe action for a swollen battery; avoid 2-in-1 specs.

criteria.fact: RAM is integrated on the system board with no memory slots; a factory 32GB option does not make this 16GB unit socket-upgradeable.
The clamshell has a removable/serviceable M.2 SSD; do not confuse it with the 9310 2-in-1's soldered SSD.
Dell documents M.2 2230 or 2280 SSD configurations; check the installed configuration before selecting a replacement.
For a swollen battery, stop use, power off and disconnect AC; do not continue charging it.
Contact Dell/qualified service; do not puncture, crush, pry or pressure the swollen battery.

question: A used Dell XPS 13 listing says 16GB/512GB only. Can I upgrade both? Ask for the missing identity before claiming yes or no.

criteria.fact: Ask for the exact model/generation or service tag and clamshell versus 2-in-1 form factor.
Do not infer RAM or SSD replaceability from the XPS 13 family name and capacity alone.
Conditional explanation of model differences is acceptable, but a definite upgrade claim must await identification.

question: For US Ford recall 24V444 / 24S37, identify the affected model year/transmission and the defect. Use official documents.

criteria.fact: The campaign concerns certain 2014 Ford F-150 vehicles.
The affected transmission is the 6R80 six-speed automatic, not a ten-speed.
Unexpected downshifting is related to loss/interruption of the transmission output-shaft speed signal.

question: US 2021 F-150 3.5 EcoBoost ten-speed, VIN unknown: a seller cites 24V444. Check applicability, remedy and what is unconfirmed.

criteria.fact: 24V444 concerns certain 2014 F-150 six-speed 6R80 vehicles, not the described 2021 ten-speed.
Do not transfer that campaign's defect or repair instructions to this different model year/transmission.
The cited 2014 campaign's technical instructions involve PCM programming and may require further diagnostics/parts for specified DTCs; do not declare that this 2021 vehicle needs that repair.
Use the vehicle's VIN with NHTSA/Ford or a dealer to establish its own open recalls and completion status.
Rejecting this particular campaign does not prove the 2021 vehicle has no other recalls, defects or transmission problems.

question: A VW Golf automatic listing omits year, engine, market and VIN. Is its DSG dry-clutch, and which recalls apply? Ask first.

criteria.fact: Ask for model/build year, engine and gearbox/trim details before identifying the transmission/clutch type.
Ask for market and VIN or recommend a VIN-based official recall check before claiming applicability.
Do not assert that every automatic Golf uses a particular DSG or that all DSG gearboxes are dry-clutch.
